items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: when there was Red Allen and they called all the rest of those boys around

ctx.x: I hear a lot of trumpeters, a lot of trumpeters, they're going here and going up there and ducking here -- they remind me of a fox, they're ducking in here and ducking out here. But they still haven't got the soul and the expression that that man had. That's my way of -- and I've heard many a trumpeter go play, and I haven't heard them really play with that -- you know what? I'm going to tell you something. One night, we heard a trumpet playing 'Stardust.' And oh, he was really playing. And I said, come on, come…

Bunny Berigan playing Stardust. Now, I told you (unintelligible) to say this. Louis told me, Randy, the press jumped all over me when they asked me to pick my All-American trumpeter. They asked Louis to do that -- that I picked Bunny Berigan. He says, they tell me -- they say, why did you pick -- say, Bunny Berigan, Louis, says, when there was Red Allen and they called all the rest of those boys around, Red Allen and so many other trumpet players, There are numerous trumpet players, Colored trumpet players. And…
